actions.name: Submit specially crafted request to vulnerable Log4j system to execute arbitrary code
actions.description: An adversary can exploit Log4Shell by submitting a specially crafted request to a vulnerable system that causes that system to execute arbitrary code.
actions.reproducibility_reason: No application fixture or explicit Log4j/JVM version is identified. Supply app, Log4j and JVM versions, configuration, and harmless validation step.

actions.name: Gain full control over system via Log4Shell exploitation
actions.description: The request allows the adversary to take full control over the system. The adversary can then steal information, launch ransomware, or conduct other malicious activity.
actions.reproducibility_reason: No application fixture or explicit Log4j/JVM version is identified. Supply app, Log4j and JVM versions, configuration, and harmless validation step.

actions.name: Scan networks to potentially exploit Log4Shell and related vulnerabilities
actions.description: Malicious cyber actors are actively scanning networks to potentially exploit Log4Shell, CVE-2021-45046, and CVE-2021-45105 in vulnerable systems.
actions.reproducibility_reason: No application fixture or explicit Log4j/JVM version is identified. Supply app, Log4j and JVM versions, configuration, and harmless validation step.

actions.name: Deploy cryptomining and botnet malware after exploiting Log4Shell
actions.description: The FBI has observed attempted exploitation and widespread scanning of the Log4j vulnerability to gain access to networks to deploy cryptomining and botnet malware.
actions.reproducibility_reason: No application fixture or explicit Log4j/JVM version is identified. Supply app, Log4j and JVM versions, configuration, and harmless validation step.
